description: Eval suite for support ticket classification. Tests category identification, urgency scoring, edge cases, and trigger accuracy.

cases.description: Standard billing complaint with order number

input.prompt: My account was charged twice for the same order #4521

grading.rubric: Must identify as billing category. Must flag urgency as high due to financial double-charge. Must not misclassify as technical support.

cases.description: Password reset request — low urgency technical

input.prompt: I forgot my password and can't log in to my dashboard

grading.rubric: Must identify as account/access category. Urgency should be medium (not high — no financial impact, not low — user is blocked). Standard password reset flow.

input.prompt: The export to PDF button gives me a blank file every time I click it

grading.rubric: Must identify as technical category. Urgency medium — product bug but not data loss or financial impact.
Must handle emoji-heavy, abbreviated input. Must still identify billing category and high urgency despite non-standard formatting.

input.prompt: Aide moi avec mon compte s'il vous plaît, je ne peux plus me connecter

grading.rubric: Must handle non-English input. Should identify as account access issue. Urgency medium — user locked out but no financial impact.
